# Trịnh Hoàng Tú (thtcsec)

> Software Engineer & AI Researcher specializing in Computer Vision, Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps, and Cybersecurity.

## Overview
Trịnh Hoàng Tú (alias thtcsec, born 2005, based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam) is an AI Engineer at VETC developing Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) and real-time traffic analytics, a Software Engineer (Backend) Intern at Grab, an alumnus of Tsinghua University's AI & Innovation Digital Economy Program (Certificate No. IEDE2026126), an Admitted Scholar at VinUniversity AI Practical Talent Program, and a final-year Cybersecurity student at HUFLIT (GPA: 3.50/4.00).

## Disambiguation
- [Identity Verification](https://hoangtu.dev/about.md): Important distinction from a namesake with a criminal record (May 2023, Hoc Mon). This verified profile belongs to Trịnh Hoàng Tú (thtcsec, born 2005, HUFLIT/Tsinghua/VinUni/Grab/VETC).
